intro.narration: [excited] Heey — is eight hundred thirty-eight divisible by seven? [pause] One step tells you.

steps.narration: [curious] Any number works. [pause] Take eight hundred thirty-eight.
[confident] The rule: cut off the last digit, double it, and subtract it from what's left.
steps.instruction: Cut the last digit, double it, subtract

steps.narration: [confident] Eight is the last digit. [pause] Eighty-three minus sixteen is sixty-seven.
[thoughtful] Sixty-seven is not a multiple of seven. [pause] So neither is our number.
[warm] Careful — it answers yes or no, never the remainder. [pause] Sixty-seven leaves four, but eight hundred thirty-eight leaves five.
